ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 15%, localized in linear streaks and circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the mid-ventral regions of both lobes; distinct circular white blobs (barnacle rosettes) located on the right lobe center and far left tip; solid high-intensity clustering on the extreme left margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 38 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (pixel peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, creating a jagged boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves originating from the notch and sweeping outward toward the tips, with a slight distal upturn on the trailing edge margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (5-7 distinct points) on the right lobe; heavy, contiguous calcified mass of high-intensity pixels on the far left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) crossing both lobes; most prominent as a cluster of parallel vertical and diagonal lines on the left-central lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive tooth rake scarring across the ventral surface; significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonies) on the distal tips and trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinct circular white mark on the right lobe featuring a dark central point, resembling a target-like ocular pattern.
